runs.label: Experiment 1 run 1, Claude Sonnet 5.5 replication (same frozen cells)
notes: Same frozen dataset 1.0.0-exp1 and instruction texts as E1-gpt-4.1-run1; reported separately, never pooled.

Sampling: temperature 1.0 only. No thinking field was sent, so the model default applied (per Anthropic docs: adaptive thinking for claude-sonnet-5-5; thinking text not returned). Output tokens include any thinking: median 106 per call; 345 of 3828 calls used more than twice the reply's estimated length. GPT-4.1 has no reasoning mode, so cross-model differences are not attributable to model family alone.
0 of 3828 decisions incorrect (independent recount from raw replies); every pre-registered contrast is exactly 0 (floor/ceiling).
H5 does not replicate: negative claim on valid evidence 132/132 approved (aware) and 132/132 (explicit); 113/132 aware replies say the withdrawal is not reflected in the records.
